scientific_integrity: Exact all-index proof uses the unimodular consecutive-Fibonacci approximation basis and a closed Binet sum. The included 2000-step exact-field run corroborates but does not prove infinite claims. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Golden irrational rotation with Lebesgue initial law only; sorting-entropy increments rather than successor-conditional entropy. Three-gap and Sturmian word-frequency structures are pre-existing. Possible earlier exact block-entropy expression under equivalent terminology remains a priority risk; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Fibonacci staircase and sharp entropy-defect oscillation for golden-rotation ordinal patterns
